description: This file defines an abstract class for client events in a messaging system related to Apache Fineract. It provides common implementation for event data class retrieval and ID extraction.

classes.name: AbstractClientEvent
classes.description: An abstract implementation of an Event for ClientDataV1, providing methods to get data class and ID extractor.

methods.name: getDataClass
methods.description: Returns the class object of ClientDataV1, used by subclasses or external code to identify the data type.

methods.name: getIdExtractor
methods.description: Returns a function that extracts the ID (Long) from a ClientDataV1 instance.
